corrections.R263: Causal group-outer/token-inner candidate accepted only under disjoint group weight slots, layer chronological QSA/GDN, PLE/callback and completion fences. Ordinary chunk-major already avoids the full residual host plane. R47 prior group idea acknowledged; no implemented/fit/numerical/performance claim.
corrections.R264: Metric capability/clock/traffic distinction accepted as a proposal. A 60s collection deadline can truncate existing >=32K requests including loading/perturbation; do not adopt it as whole-request proof. Set a finite owner deadline from matched baseline plus margin, and qualify entire required span or explicitly bounded partial scope. +/-10% overhead cutoff is a proposed heuristic, not a validated accuracy contract. Official latest Sysman memory page contradicts its byte member descriptions with a generic 32-byte-transaction note; do not blindly multiply API deltas by32 or assume32bit rollover. Pin installed implementation/unit/width and validate known-byte control before physical-traffic join. Source: https://oneapi-src.github.io/level-zero-spec/level-zero/latest/sysman/api/apis/memory.html
